column1: # Canonical UI label catalog (i18n) - PORTABLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
# Applied at startup by UiTranslationSyncService to ANY active database
# (SQLite and PostgreSQL) through JPA: this mechanism keeps localizations
# RULE: add every NEW UI key HERE, never in DemoDataRepository's
# seedLabelTranslations* methods (SQLite-only SQL, not run under the PostgreSQL profile).
# TSV format, one record per line, with seven TAB-separated fields:
#   key <TAB> description <TAB> it <TAB> en <TAB> fr <TAB> es <TAB> de
# All five languages are required and must be non-empty (verified by UiTranslationCatalogTest).
# Empty lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Values cannot contain TAB characters.
# Synchronization is ADDITIVE: it never overwrites translations already present in the database
# (changes made on the Labels page remain intact).
